one_liner: FanBasis has a REST public API with scoped x-api-key keys from the seller dashboard, plus sandbox and webhooks; no official MCP.
auth_notes: Public API uses x-api-key header with scoped keys. OAuth 2.0 with PKCE is mentioned only in a partner integration (Aura) and is gated; no public OAuth docs found.
access_notes: API key is found in the seller/merchant dashboard under the API section; no sign of a paid plan requirement in the evidence. Sandbox environment exists. Account signup terms not fully verified.
blocker_notes: Docs are at apidocs.fan; the evidence comes largely from third-party mirrors of the docs.

evidence.quote: No OAuth, no client ID/secret pairs — Fanbasis uses a single API key with separate test/live environments.
You can find your API key in your merchant dashboard under the API section.
Full Fanbasis API integration: checkout sessions, customers, subscribers, discount codes, products, transactions, refunds, and webhook management.
Zapier FanBasis MCP lets you connect FanBasis's actions with any AI tool that supports MCP
